Name: BiggerBackpack_Simplified_Chinese_7.3
Author: kzrdoubao
Description:
[size=4]Description[/size]
Buy a bigger backpack at Pierre's for only 50,000g! This backpack has 48 slots.

[size=4]Config[/size]
[i]Note: run Stardew Valley once with this mod enabled to generate the [code]config.json
[/code][/i][list]
[*][code]BackpackCost
[/code]: How much you have to pay to buy this backpack in the shop. Default = 50000).
[/list][size=4]Console Commands[/size][list]
[*][code]player_setbackpacksize slots
[/code]: Changes the size of your inventory. Valid values for slots are 12, 24, 36 and 48. Items in the removed slots will be spilled onto the ground.
[/list][size=4]Dependencies[/size]
This mod requires the following mods to be installed:[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3213]StardewHack[/url]
[/list][size=4]Known bugs[/size]
Please report bugs on [list]
[*]This mod does not support android / mobile.
[/list][size=4]Uninstalling[/size]
To remove the mod, first run [code]player_setbackpacksize 36[/code] in the SMAPI console and safe your game.
